back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

“Go and proclaim so the people of Jerusalem can hear: the LORD says this: ‘I remember your steadfast love when you were young, your love like that of a bride newly wed, how you followed Me into the wilderness, into a land that had not yet been sown.’”
Israel was a holy thing to the LORD, the firstfruits of His produce. Everyone who devoured Israel was guilty; disaster came upon them — so declares the LORD.’”
O house of Jacob, and all you clans of the house of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
The LORD says this: “What injustice did your fathers find in Me, that they drew far away from Me, and followed worthless things, and so became worthless people themselves?

They did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and pits, a land of drought and darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?’
I brought you into a fertile land, to eat its fruit and its bounty, but when you came in, you defiled My land and made My inheritance a detestable thing.
The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD?’ The experts in the law did not know Me; the shepherds of the people rebelled against Me; and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed useless things.
Therefore I will still bring a case against you, declares the LORD, and I will bring a case against your descendants too.
Cross over to the coasts of the Kittim and look; send to Kedar and consider carefully; see whether there has ever been anything like this:
Has any nation ever changed its gods? — though those things are not gods at all. Yet My people have exchanged their Glory for what is useless.
Be stunned at this, O heavens; be horrified and utterly appalled, declares the LORD.
For My people have done two evils: they have forsaken Me, the fountain of living water, and have dug for themselves cisterns — cracked cisterns that cannot hold water.
Is Israel a slave? Was he born a slave in the house? Then why has he become prey for plunderers?
Young lions roar at him, they roar loudly; they have made his land a desolation, his cities are burned with no one living in them.
Even the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head.
Have you not brought this upon yourself, by forsaking the LORD your God at the time when He was leading you along the way?
Now what will you gain by going to Egypt to drink the waters of the Shihor? And what will you gain by going to Assyria to drink the waters of the Euphrates River?

Your own wickedness will punish you, and your turning away from God will be the charge against you. Know and realize how evil and bitter it is that you have forsaken the LORD your God, and that there is no fear of Me in you — so declares the LORD of Hosts.
For long ago I broke your yoke and tore off your chains, but you said, ‘I will not serve!’ Indeed, on every high hill and under every green tree you lay down like a prostitute.
I planted you like a choice vine, from wholly genuine seed. How then did you turn before Me into a degenerate vine, a wild vine?
Even if you wash yourself with lye and use much soap, the stain of your guilt still remains before Me — so declares the Lord GOD.

How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not followed the Baals’? Look at your conduct in the valley; acknowledge what you have done. You are like a swift young she-camel running back and forth on her ways,

like a wild donkey at home in the wilderness; when her heart burns with lust she sniffs the wind. Who can restrain her desire? All who seek her need not weary themselves; in her mating season they will find her.
Restrain your foot from going bare and your throat from thirst! But you said, ‘It is hopeless! No — for I love foreign gods, and after them I will go.’
As a thief is ashamed when he is caught, so the house of Israel is ashamed — they, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets,

who say to a piece of wood, ‘You are my father,’ and to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ For they have turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Yet in the time of their trouble they cry, ‘Please rise up and save us!’
But where are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them rise up and save you in your time of trouble, if they can! For your gods are as many as your cities, O Judah.
Why do you bring a case against Me? You have all rebelled against Me — so declares the LORD.
In vain I struck your children; they took no discipline. Your own sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion.
O people of this generation, consider the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of thick darkness? Why do My people say, ‘We are free to roam; we will come to You no more’?
Can a young woman forget her ornaments, or a bride her wedding sash? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number.
How skillful you are at seeking love! So skillful that even wicked women could learn your ways.
Moreover, on the hem of your garment is found the blood of the innocent poor — though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all these things
you still say, ‘I am innocent; surely His anger has turned away from me.’ Behold, I will bring you to judgment, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
Why do you go about so easily, changing your ways? You will be put to shame by Egypt, just as you were once put to shame by Assyria.
You will also leave that place with your hands on your head, for the LORD has rejected those you trust; you will gain no success through them.”
